rules.link_resolution: A link is resolved only when its self-record evidence list names at least one declared entry with access opened and a local repository file. An empty list or only non-opened entries leaves it unresolved. A missing opened file is refused.
rules.licence: Use the ordinal depth after mapping assessed with no runnable basis to worked. Worked licenses a worked case or written exercise, not a measurement. Executable and assessed with a runnable basis license only the declared task over that basis.
rules.weakest_link: An unresolved link is weakest. Otherwise the minimum effective depth sets the chain depth. Report the first topic at that minimum and count links below the maximum effective depth.
rules.unresolved_breaks_chain: A chain with any unresolved link cannot be reported as a supported claim.
rules.no_biological_conclusion: A chain cannot establish a conclusion about a compound, target or therapy.

boundary_statement: A chain establishes that each named link's material exists and says what it says. It does not establish a claim about a compound, a target or a therapy. Its endpoints are only the topics it names.
excluded_by_design: Any claim that a chain establishes a compound, a target or a therapy
Any ranking of chains by completeness
Any use of the self record's depth as evidence that the underlying material is correct
Any conclusion beyond the named topic endpoints
